characters.description: The innkeeper of the Wandering Inn, where people from hostile groups can meet under her protection. After helping rescue captives from Liscor's dungeon, she gives the survivors a quiet place to recover.
characters.name: Erin

characters.description: A young Gnoll newly returned from captivity in Liscor's dungeon. Mrsha is frightened by food and familiar surroundings, keeps a wand close for reassurance, and slowly begins to understand that she is free while Erin and Lionette care for her.
characters.name: Mrsha

characters.description: Mrsha's guardian and a manager at Erin's inn. Lionette is intensely protective after the young Gnoll returns from captivity, patiently helping her face ordinary food and familiar surroundings while recognizing that recovery will take time.
characters.name: Lionette

characters.description: A half-elf adventurer and leader of the Horns of Hammerad, recently rescued from the dungeon and reunited with her team. Ceria is still carrying the effects of captivity and believes Calruz was mentally altered, though she does not excuse what he did.
characters.name: Ceria

characters.description: A fighter in the reunited Horns of Hammerad. Yvlon welcomes Ceria back after the dungeon rescue and joins her companions in considering their recovered rewards, Calruz's condition, and what the team should do next.
characters.name: Yvlon

characters.description: A necromancer in the reunited Horns of Hammerad. Pisces welcomes Ceria back after her rescue and joins the team's discussion of the dungeon expedition and its aftermath.
characters.name: Pisces

characters.description: An Antinium member of the reunited Horns of Hammerad. Ksmvr is present when Ceria returns from captivity and the team considers its recovered rewards and future.
characters.name: Ksmvr

characters.description: The captured Minotaur who led the furred hunters in Liscor's dungeon and once captained Ceria's adventuring team. Ceria believes his mind was impaired during the captives' ordeal, but regards that only as context, not forgiveness.
characters.name: Calruz

characters.description: An influential Drake Wall Lord involved in the aftermath of Liscor's dungeon expedition. Ilvriss publicly credits the allied forces for the city's victory.
characters.name: Ilvriss

characters.description: A young Cave Goblin among those Erin shelters after the dungeon uprising. Pebblesnatch arrives with the injured Goblin group and joins the broader gathering that turns a tense encounter outside Selim into a shared day of baseball.
characters.name: Pebblesnatch

characters.description: The young chieftain of the hunted Flooded Waters tribe. Rags keeps her exhausted people moving under cavalry pressure, trusts selected officers to support her command, and begins questioning the cycle of retaliation between Humans and Goblins.
characters.name: Rags

characters.description: An injured scout who directs mounted fighters for the Flooded Waters tribe. Red Scar supports Rags and helps their weary people continue the march south.
characters.name: Red Scar

characters.description: A Flooded Waters fighter who survives the battle for Liscor and gathers with the remnants under Rags.
characters.name: Poison Bite

characters.description: An advanced magic-user in Rags's tribe whose personal name is uncertain. The Goblin spellcaster hunts with lightning and helps the Flooded Waters survive while human cavalry drives the exhausted tribe south.
characters.name: Goblin spellcaster

characters.description: The former chieftain of the Redfang warriors who now follow Rags. Garen challenges their transfer of loyalty and holds a key connected to an old Goblin legacy, placing him at the center of a dispute with Rags, Tremborag, and an approaching Goblin Lord.
characters.name: Garen Redfang

characters.description: Great Chieftain of the mountain-settlement tribe and a hostile rival of Rags. Tremborag considers the Flooded Waters traitors for leaving his settlement and competes with Garen Redfang and the Goblin Lord for influence over the migrating Goblin host.
characters.name: Tremborag

characters.description: Liscor's strategist and the author of its account of the dungeon battle. Olesm reports that Goblins helped rescue the captives, warns that the dungeon remains a Gold-rank threat, and gains formal recognition from Liscor's army for his conduct.
characters.name: Olesm

characters.description: A Goblin necromancer commanding Goblin soldiers and undead while a human army drives his forces south. The Goblin Lord says that he serves a master but is not enslaved.
characters.name: Goblin Lord

characters.description: A Goblin Lord and necromancer whose army marches under human pressure. Rhys once shared a close bond with Garen Redfang, but their paths divided after Rhys entered a necromancer's service and began using undead forces.
characters.name: Rhys

characters.description: A captive Drake officer travelling with forces commanded by Rhys. He keeps her alive for her knowledge, with restraints placed on her wings.
characters.name: Captive Drake officer

characters.description: A trusted lieutenant serving Rags in the Flooded Waters tribe. Quietstab helps maintain the tribe's command structure during its uneasy alignment with other Goblin factions, until Tremborag secretly kills him and conceals the body.
characters.name: Quietstab

characters.description: An individual Antinium worker who guards Erin's inn and hunts birds with a bow. Bird is only about two years old, treasures the signs of friendship he receives, and explains that individuality can place unnamed workers in danger from their own Hive.
characters.name: Bird

characters.description: One of five Redfang Hobgoblins leading and tending the Cave Goblins freed from the dungeon. Head Scratcher is wounded after the uprising but remains active in their care.
characters.name: Head Scratcher

characters.description: One of five Redfang Hobgoblins leading and tending the Cave Goblins freed from the dungeon. Numbtongue joins the injured group that Erin treats and invites to the meadow.
characters.name: Numbtongue

characters.description: One of five Redfang Hobgoblins leading and tending the Cave Goblins freed from the dungeon. Rabbit Eater joins the injured group that Erin treats and invites to the meadow.
characters.name: Rabbit Eater

characters.description: One of five Redfang Hobgoblins leading and tending the Cave Goblins freed from the dungeon. Bad Arrow joins the injured group that Erin treats and invites to the meadow.
characters.name: Bad Arrow

characters.description: One of five Redfang Hobgoblins leading and tending the Cave Goblins freed from the dungeon. Shorthilt joins the injured group that Erin treats and invites to the meadow.
characters.name: Shorthilt

characters.description: A Selim performer who prevents panic when Erin arrives with Goblin guests by presenting them as her employees. Wesle's Method Acting allows him to reproduce rehearsed roles and skills within limits.
characters.name: Wesle

characters.description: The deputy leader of the Gold-rank Wings of Palace adventuring team. While awaiting talks over recovered artifacts, Bavusa meets Bird and comes to see the young Antinium as an individual.
characters.name: Bavusa

characters.description: A member of the Halfseekers involved in negotiations over artifacts recovered from Liscor's dungeon. Jelaqua seeks armor while the Wings of Palace pursue a light-spell shortsword.
characters.name: Jelaqua

characters.description: A veteran Goblin Lord who enters the Cave Goblins' refuge disguised as a frail elder. He challenges the five Redfang Hobgoblins, defeats them with ease, and catastrophically wounds Bird after Bird nearly strikes him with an arrow.
characters.name: Older Goblin Lord

characters.description: A senior Liscor guardsman who recognizes that ordinary treatment cannot save Bird. Klbkch takes the catastrophically injured Antinium to the Queen for help.
characters.name: Klbkch

characters.description: Liscor's Watch Captain, responsible for city security as siege approaches. Zevara manages the recovery of Erin's stolen magical door, restricts unsafe travel through it, and weighs the danger posed by the Goblin force gathering outside the walls.
characters.name: Zevara

characters.description: A Gnoll civic leader and Royal Shopkeeper who helps organize Liscor's Gnolls. Krshia privately tests Mrsha's unusual access to a guarded spell book and prepares to protect both the child and the book as the city faces siege.
characters.name: Krshia

characters.description: Rags's effective second-in-command after her tribe absorbs many of Tremborag's former followers. Pyrite combines mining knowledge with trained combat perception, proves his value in battle against eater goats, and openly supports Rags's authority.
characters.name: Pyrite

characters.description: The human commander whose campaign drives the Goblin armies toward Liscor. Tyrion Veltross intends to use trebuchets and the Goblin advance to breach the city before destroying the surviving Goblins.
characters.name: Tyrion Veltross

characters.description: Leader of the Painted Antinium and an emerging religious practice among individual workers. Pawn brings soldiers and a light-producing censer to Erin's inn, where the Antinium meet Goblin refugees through signs, speech, music, and dance.
characters.name: Pawn

characters.description: The Free Queen's only individual cook, timid and isolated within the Hive despite his considerable skill. Gary receives leave to visit Erin's inn, wins a cooking contest among the Goblin refugees, and begins working with Erin as a fellow expert.
characters.name: Gary

characters.description: A blind human ruler travelling with the army driving the Goblins toward Liscor. Laken Godart's imperial awareness depends on nearby marker-totems, and he comes to regard his own part in enabling the approaching war as morally wrong.
characters.name: Laken Godart

characters.description: A former decorated military sergeant and the father of Liscor's wing commander. Ralk faces the approaching siege as a city defender and receives his daughter's will, while admitting that experience alone cannot solve the crisis.
characters.name: Ralk

characters.description: Ralk's daughter and a wing commander preparing to defend Liscor from the approaching siege. Embrya gives her father her will before the battle.
characters.name: Embrya

characters.description: A powerful Human political figure seeking to prevent the approaching war. Magnolia Reinhart concludes that diplomacy will not stop the human campaign against Liscor and begins an undisclosed intervention despite the political cost.
characters.name: Magnolia Reinhart

characters.description: A distinct sergeant among the Painted Antinium soldiers preparing to deploy in Liscor's defense.
characters.name: Yellow Splatters

characters.description: The necromancer directing Rhys through a magical control link. Az'kerash orders the Goblin Lord to attack Liscor, promises undead support raised from the battle's casualties, and treats both the Goblin army and the human assault as parts of his plan.
characters.name: Az'kerash
